visited_community_reference.facts_used: Catalog unlock/held distinctions and exchanging out versus rewards must be kept separate; page carries incompleteness and timeliness caveats. Latest webpage does not silently replace the pinned calculation/catalog snapshot.

lookup_implementation: Exact version and item ID reverse membership; same names and same images never merge. All bundled memberships verified. Separate overlapping observations retain original denominators. Input collections are not reward pools.
input_boundary: Final native contract sends Qt mouse events only to owned viewport and emits the armed timer; no global cursor movement or hardware-hover claim. Initial desktop pointer moved away from target during delayed check; failed original retained.
